from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    line_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in row_lines] + [grid[0][c] for c in col_lines]
    separator = Counter(line_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_cuts = [r for r in row_lines if grid[r][0] == separator]
    col_cuts = [c for c in col_lines if grid[0][c] == separator]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            tiles.append([grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)])
    fill = Counter(v for tile in tiles for v in tile).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(v != fill for v in tile) == 2 else fill for tile in tiles[i:i+len(col_bounds)-1]] for i in range(0, len(tiles), len(col_bounds)-1)]
'''
task_file=program_dir/'task-506e4a3d.py'
task_file.write_text(code)
print(task_file)
